```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Fetch server data from database
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../assets/data/site_data.db")
server <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT * FROM servers
  WHERE server_name = 'TEST-DB-01'
")
dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Description

Testing database server for QA validation and automated testing frameworks. Contains anonymized test datasets covering various scenarios and edge cases. Supports database performance testing and query optimization experiments. Regularly reset to known good state for consistent test execution. Enables parallel test execution without interfering with development or production environments.
:::
:::
:::

## Server Specifications

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(DT)

# Create the specs data for the table
specs_data <- data.frame(
  Specification = c("Server Name", "Environment", "CPU Cores", "RAM (GB)",
                    "Storage (TB)", "Uptime (%)", "Current Load (%)",
                    "Location", "Status", "Health", "Total Capacity Score"),
  Value = c(
    server$server_name,
    server$environment,
    as.character(server$cpu_cores),
    as.character(server$ram_gb),
    as.character(server$storage_tb),
    paste0(round(server$uptime_pct, 2), "%"),
    paste0(server$current_load_pct, "%"),
    server$location,
    server$status,
    server$health,
    as.character(round(server$total_capacity_score, 2))
  )
)

datatable(specs_data,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 15,
            searching = FALSE,
            ordering = FALSE,
            dom = 't',
            columnDefs = list(list(width = '40%', targets = 0),
                             list(width = '60%', targets = 1))
          ),
          colnames = c("", ""),
          rownames = FALSE,
          class = 'cell-border stripe')
```
